groups.name: Expense Managers
groups.description: Line managers who approve their team's expense claims

groups.name: Expense Finance
groups.description: Finance staff who export approved claims to payroll

roles.name: Employee
roles.description: Creates, edits, submits and withdraws their own claims and follows their status. Never sees anyone else's claims.

roles.name: Manager
roles.description: Approves or rejects the claims of the people assigned to them, never their own, and sees no other team's claims. Also files their own claims like any employee.

roles.name: Finance
roles.description: Assigns line managers, and exports approved claims to payroll and downloads past exports. Sees approved claims only, never drafts or pending claims, and cannot approve or reject.
